motorsport-total.com: 74. The gap: framing.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But other sites can frame the page.

Lesson: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in the CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, so other sites cannot frame your pages.

meutimao.com.br: 64. The gap: cookie flags.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 11 cookies are sent without Secure, and 3 session cookies are readable by scripts.

Lesson: Set Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite on every cookie that scripts do not need to read.
